title: glehnia littoralis
intro: Glehnia littoralis, commonly known as Japanese Angelica, is a perennial plant native to East Asia, particularly in China, Japan, and Korea. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Glehnia littoralis include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display potential anticancer properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Glehnia littoralis include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
